retirement_age.notes: Normal pension age under the general social security scheme is 66 years and 9 months in 2026 (stored as 66.75) and rises to 66 years and 11 months in 2027. It is reset every year by ministerial order based on life expectancy at 65. Early retirement from 60 is possible with 40+ years of contributions, with a reduction.
